Eco-Friendly Features

Our non-woven bags use recycled PP (polypropylene) fabric, reducing plastic waste by repurposing post-consumer materials. Each bag replaces 100+ single-use plastic bags and decomposes 3x faster than conventional plastic. Certified recyclable and ideal for eco-conscious brand campaigns.

Custom Printing Options

We offer four professional printing methods to match your design complexity, budget, and order quantity. Our team will recommend the most suitable technique based on your artwork and target quantity to maximize both visual impact and cost efficiency.

  • Silk-screen: Best for 1-3 color simple logos
  • Heat Transfer: Full color, photo-quality printing
  • Offset Lamination: Laminated surface for premium look
  • UV Printing: Direct printing with UV curing for vibrant colors

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity?

100 pcs per design.

Are non-woven bags truly eco-friendly?

Yes, PP non-woven bags are reusable 50+ times and decompose faster than plastic.

Can I choose custom colors?

We offer 20+ stock colors and custom PMS color matching for orders above 1,000 pcs.

How do die-cut handles compare to loop handles?

Die-cut handles are integrated into the bag body (cost-effective). Loop handles are sewn on (more durable, premium feel).

What's the production timeline?

5-12 business days for standard orders. Rush service available.

Not Sure Which Bag to Choose?

Tell us your needs and budget, our consultants will recommend the best solution.
